compiled_state.description:
## Why

Debugging-orchestration sessions periodically sweep for AWS + GitHub Actions errors
"since the last sweep." Passing the last-sweep timeline across sessions needs a durable,
zero-noise carrier. We already use a dedicated long-lived `session_log` ticket
(`tomophobic-stilllife-mayfly` / `b2dc-b1ab-0bd9-47f6`, tagged `ops-sweep`) as an
append-only ledger, but the convention is undocumented, so future sessions cannot
reliably discover or extend it. `session_log` is the right carrier precisely because it
is excluded from default `list`, `ready`/`next-batch`, and graph-health, and never syncs
to Jira — an always-open ledger creates zero work-queue noise.

## What

Document the "ops error-sweep ledger" convention in the docs and add a one-line pointer
in AGENTS.md so debug sessions discover it. This is a DOCS-ONLY change — no source or
test code is touched.

- `docs/user-guide.md`: add a new subsection (e.g. "### Ops error-sweep ledger") in/after
  the existing "## Session logs" section, matching that section's concise, example-driven
  style. Cover: the ledger is a `session_log` ticket (and why — queue/graph/Jira
  exclusion); the current ledger id/alias + `ops-sweep` tag; discovery via
  `rebar search "ops-sweep"`; the newest comment / `SWEEP <ISO-8601> | window <start>..<end>`
  header convention and next-window rule; appending with `rebar comment <ledger-id>` (NOT
  `session-log append`, which is session-keyed and auto-rotates); linking filed tickets
  with `rebar link <filed> <ledger-id> relates_to` (non-blocking relations only); and how
  to recreate the ledger (`session-log start` + `tag ... ops-sweep`), with the tag+search
  as the durable anchor.
- `AGENTS.md`: extend ONLY the existing one-line "Session logs" pointer bullet under
  "Where to read" to mention the ops error-sweep ledger convention. Keep it a pointer, not
  restated content (AGENTS.md policy: already-documented topics are one-line pointers into
  docs/).

## Scope

- Files: `docs/user-guide.md` (new subsection), `AGENTS.md` (one-line pointer extension).
- Out of scope: any code/test change; restating the full convention in AGENTS.md.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `docs/user-guide.md` has a new subsection under "## Session logs" documenting the
      ops error-sweep ledger convention accurately: session_log rationale, ledger id/alias
      + `ops-sweep` tag, discovery via search, the `SWEEP ... | window ...` header +
      next-window rule, append via `rebar comment` (not `session-log append`), link via
      `relates_to`, and recreation via `session-log start` + tag.
- [x] `AGENTS.md`'s existing "Session logs" pointer bullet is extended by one line/clause
      to mention the ops error-sweep ledger convention — a pointer only, no restated body.
- [x] The convention text matches the mechanics in docs/event-schema.md ("The session_log
      ticket type") and docs/user-guide.md ("Session logs") — no contradictions.
- [x] `make lint` passes; no new tooling added; no source/test files changed.
